Pezulu Tree House Lodge exclusive luxury meets the untamed wilderness
Nothing but breathing the air of Africa, and actually walking through it, can communicate the indescribable sensations.
William Burchell – English explorer
exclusive luxury meets the untamed wilderness
Welcome
Pezulu Tree House Lodge is a small exclusive Game Lodge, situated in the Greater Kruger game rich area of Hoedspruit, Limpopo Province, South Africa. . With each treehouse built around the canopy of growing trees, our unique accommodation fuses nature and comfort. Built to celebrate its surroundings, the lodge is intentionally small, to keep the experience personal for each guest.
Whether you’re after excitement or tranquility, Pezulu is perfect for escaping the hustle and bustle of modern life. With a wide variety of experiences, being near to the Panorama Route and the world famous Kruger National Park, visiting Pezulu is something you’ll simply never forget.
there’s nowhere on earth quite like Pezulu Tree House Lodge

pages.title: The Lodge – Pezulu Tree House Lodge
pages.text:
The Lodge Pezulu Tree House Lodge
“ Africa changes you forever, like nowhere on earth. Once you have been there, you will never be the same. ”
Brian Jackman freelance writer
Pezulu is all about making memories
The Lodge
Pezulu is a one-of-a-kind place, with a friendly team who strives to provide unmatched experiences and service to ensure every minute is a memory. The thatched main building of the lodge is interweaved with a large Marula tree. Inside you’ll find a cosy lounge, reception, a dining area and a charming bush bar.
Our magnificent rock pool is the place to be if you need to unwind on hot summer days. Grab a pool lounger and let the stress melt away! Once the heat of the sun subsides, enjoy a drink at the panoramic lookout point as the vibrant African sun sets over the Drakensberg mountains.
A delicious 3 course dinner is served under the stars around a log fire in our beautiful boma. And if you’d like to celebrate something special, simply ask!
